ui_widget.text: Deliver 8 iron ingots to the hub.
A VAST FACTORY BUILT ONE PHASE AT A TIME

1. Place a miner on iron ore.
2. Put a furnace to its right.
3. Lay conveyors from the furnace to the hub.
4. Deliver the contract to advance a phase.

Complete all three phases in a tier to advance. The objective card shows the next unlock. Build a generator on coal and connect power poles once electricity unlocks.
